sources.title: Official resort maps
sources.note: Five maps visually inspected: Levels 1, 2, 3, 4 and 14. Diagrammatic, with no usable metric scale. Labels may mix update dates.

sources.title: Level 1 — arrivals and casino
sources.note: Strip entrances at the east; hotel registration and motor court at the west. Both tower elevator banks and casino escalators are identified.

sources.title: Level 2 — bridge connections
sources.note: East/southeast bridges cross Las Vegas Boulevard and Harmon Avenue. West connection is labeled toward Aria, Vdara and Bellagio. Marquee entrance is shown; this does not establish the elevation of its outdoor pool.

sources.title: Level 3 — dining and pool approach
sources.note: Dining frontage around Boulevard Tower and the onward escalator to Boulevard Pool; Chelsea event spaces and connecting circulation.

sources.title: Level 4 — Boulevard Pool
sources.note: Pool and bars at the Strip side, conference floor toward Chelsea. The map omits Overlook Grill, which the official restaurant directions place beside this pool.

sources.title: Level 14 — Chelsea Pool
sources.note: Chelsea Pool, spa and recreation deck. The illustration names a tennis court; current fitness page also describes pickleball courts. Floor label does not establish height above grade.

sources.title: Pool District and bungalow terraces
sources.note: Distinct Boulevard, Chelsea and Marquee pool areas. Bungalows face Marquee and include multiple levels, private terraces and plunge pools.

sources.title: Boulevard Pool photographs
sources.note: Reference collection for pool shape, deck tiers, railings, cabanas and the Strip-facing edge. Detailed visual survey remains to be completed.

sources.title: Chelsea Pool photographs
sources.note: Reference collection for landscaped pool deck, cabanas and poolside furniture. Detailed visual survey remains to be completed.

sources.title: Overlook Grill — official location and directions
sources.note: Poolside cafe next to Boulevard Pool. Directions take guests from the casino through Levels 2 and 3 to Level 4; the restaurant is left of the arriving escalator. Photo survey must establish patio boundaries.

sources.title: Fitness centers and rooftop courts
sources.note: Chelsea recreation facilities are labeled Level 14. Current description includes tennis and pickleball; reconcile with the older-looking map before detailing.
